<div class="hero-eyebrow">Peer-reviewed &amp; preprints, newest first</div>

```{python}
#| output: asis

import html as _html
from pubs_lib import load_entries, format_authors, meta_line, links_line, stamp_for, to_bibtex_string

for entry in load_entries():
    stamp_text, stamp_class = stamp_for(entry)
    year = entry.get("year", "")
    title = entry.get("title", "").strip("{}")
    authors = format_authors(entry.get("author", ""))
    meta = meta_line(entry)
    note = entry.get("note")
    links = links_line(entry)

    bibtex_escaped = _html.escape(to_bibtex_string(entry))

    print('<div class="pub-card">')
    print(f'<div class="pub-year">{year}</div>')
    print('<div>')
    print(f'<span class="stamp {stamp_class}">{stamp_text}</span>')
    print()
    print(f'### {title}')
    print()
    print(f'{authors}. {meta}')
    print()
    if note:
        print(f'<div class="pub-meta">{note}</div>')

    print('<div class="pub-links">')
    print("\n".join(links))
    print('<a href="#" class="cite-toggle" onclick="'
          f"this.closest('.pub-links').querySelector('.cite-box').classList.toggle('open');return false;"
          '">Cite</a>')
    print('</div>')

    print(f'<pre class="cite-box"><code>{bibtex_escaped}</code></pre>')

    print('</div>')
    print('</div>')
    print()
```
